data.assumption: “கடந்த மாதம் சென்னை orders-ல் cancel ஆன சதவீதம்” means cancelled/canceled non-test orders divided by all non-test Chennai orders, multiplied by 100, for August 2026 using business_date.
data.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(o.status) IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN cities c ON c.city_id = s.city_id
WHERE o.is_test = FALSE
  AND c.name = 'Chennai'
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
